methods.label: Subtract nested square areas
methods.explanation:
Because the squares share their left and bottom edges, each smaller square fits inside the larger ones. The visible shaded pieces are the part of the side-\(10\) square outside the side-\(9\) square and the part of the side-\(7\) square outside the side-\(4\) square. These pieces do not overlap, so their areas add:
\[
(10^2-9^2)+(7^2-4^2)
=(100-81)+(49-16)
=19+33=52.
\]
The shaded area is \(\boxed{52}\) square units, choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
